caption: Misalignment sensitivity. Small cross-view surface repeatability does not imply reliable reference-defined volume: route-level volume error rises under alignment offsets and reaches 80.5% in the tested misalignment route. Results are descriptive repeated synthetic subsets, not independent samples.
data_origin: Sealed result summaries and identified local public-data inputs.
limitations: Descriptive evidence only; correlated views/subsets are not independent subjects.
Synthetic mesh-rendered depth is not a physical sensor measurement.
